description: Per-subagent lane visibility for parallel fan-outs in the cockpit. When the lifecycle runs 2-3 agents in parallel (Phase-1 research, Phase-3 competing mandates), the cockpit shows only an aggregate '3 running' counter instead of each worker's mandate label, live status, and streamed output. Completes ITEM-25a's explicitly-deferred agent_run/parallel-step tracking. Cross-repo: Stratum stamps each parallel worker's stream events with a stable scoped step id + human label; Compose renders one lane per worker, reusing the existing AgentPanel per-agent renderer.
phase: COMP-AGENT-LANES: Per-subagent lanes for parallel fan-outs
